name: sdp
description: Shared staged-workflow plugin for Codex with an external Claude Code review gate and agy fallback.

interface.shortDescription: Run SDP staged workflows in Codex
interface.longDescription: SDP packages single-task, batch, worktree-dispatch, and precompact workflows for Codex and exposes a bundled MCP review gate that asks Claude Code first and falls back to agy only on infrastructure failure.
